g.text: Counts and ports in the completed factorial experiment
B = Base; C = Counts; P = Ports; CP = Counts+Ports. Primary: full test at each run’s validation-selected epoch.
Five seeds per cell. Left: cell means with 95% t intervals and individual seeds. Right: paired-seed 95% t intervals.
Intervals condition on this dataset and protocol; secondary comparisons are exploratory and unadjusted. No causal decomposition is implied.
